environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as root (UID 0) with hostPath volume mount for /tmp. The MESSAGE_SPOOL_DIR is set to /tmp/iot_spool on the host filesystem. No securityContext constraints. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with full filesystem access. Other pods and host processes share the /tmp namespace. PgBouncer is configured in session mode with allow_raw_sql=true.
